description: Simulated Codex CLI installed-plugin context (TEST-033, AC-033). Same packaged-copy-only shape as the other two runtimes, but the host reaches the scripts through per-file symlinks into a separate real tree -- mirroring T-003's own codex-cli TEST-027 fixture, which uses the identical symlink variation to prove __file__ resolution, not the invocation path, decides artifact discovery.
